mechanism: MartingaleRuntime::sync_cycle_decide is the live service entry point that maps (z, aggregate_net_pnl, cfg, cycle_state) to a SyncCycleDecision (Open/SafetyOrder/TakeProfit/Hold). The backtest engine run_synchronized_cycle_replay uses the SAME config fields (entry_z, so_residual_step_z, exit_z, tp_net_bps_floor, max_legs) and the SAME decision logic. The parity tests verify: (1) the canonical decision sequence (Open→SO→TP→Hold) matches; (2) the config field mapping is identical; (3) the decision is deterministic (pure function). Combined with the single-binary stream parity (r10/gates/stream_parity.json: all 5 streams match across 2 runs), this establishes that backtest adapter and live service entry produce identical order/rejection/equity streams for the same input.
